ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure is an axisymmetric figure. If $\angle A=36^\circ, \angle C'=24^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since the figure is an axisymmetric figure, \\
therefore, $\angle C = \angle C' = 24^\circ$,\\
since $\angle A = 36^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle B = 180^\circ - \angle A - \angle C = \boxed{120^\circ}$.
